title: Unfair Terms in a Housing Contract

content.scenario: A homeowner, Priya, discovered that her housing contract included a term that allowed the builder to unilaterally increase the price of the property without notice. She filed a complaint before the State Commission, arguing that this term was unfair.
content.outcome: The State Commission declared the term allowing unilateral price increases as unfair and null and void, protecting Priya and other homeowners from potential exploitation by the builder.
